titleEn: Royal Kram No. 1021/009 on the approval of the Free Trade Agreement between the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia and the Government of the People's Republic of China

articles.en: The Free Trade Agreement between the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia and the Government of the People’s Republic of China, signed by the Kingdom of Cambodia in Phnom Penh on 12 October 2020, the full text of which is annexed hereto, is hereby approved.

This Law is declared to be urgent.
Day [illegible] of the waxing moon, B.E. 2565; done at the Royal Palace, 09 October 2021.
[Illegible in source: seal and registration number]
Norodom Sihamoni, having respectfully submitted to the King for signature; Prime Minister, Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen; Minister of Commerce, Kitti Nitikosol Bandit Pan Sorasak.
